EC1: Meets criteria for Major Depressive Episode, [AND] by Diagnostic Statistical Manual of Mental Disorder - IV (TR) criteria
EC2: Clinically significant agitation /aggression for which either 1) the frequency of agitation /aggression  as assessed by the NPI is 'Very frequently', [OR] or 2) the frequency of agitation /aggression [OR] as assessed by the NPI is 'Frequently' [AND] AND the severity of the agitation  as assessed by the NPI is 'Moderate', [OR] or 'Marked'
EC3: Clinically significant delusions for which either 1) the frequency of delusions  as assessed by the NPI is 'Very frequently', [OR] or 2) the frequency of delusions  as assessed by the NPI is 'Frequently' [AND] AND the severity of the delusions  as assessed by the NPI is 'Moderate', [OR] or 'Marked'
EC4: Clinically significant hallucinations for which either 1) the frequency of hallucinations  as assessed by the NPI is 'Very frequently', [OR] or 2) the frequency of hallucinations as assessed by the NPI is 'Frequently' [AND] AND the severity of the hallucinations [AND] as assessed by the NPI is 'Moderate', [OR] or 'Marked'
EC5: Treatment with psychotropic medications  in the 2 weeks prior to randomization with the [NOT] exception of approved treatments for dementia  (ChEIs and memantine) [OR], selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor antidepressants [OR], and trazodone (if used as an aid to facilitate sleep and not as an antidepressant); other psychotropics ([AND] with the [NOT] exclusion of antipsychotics) [OR] , if stable for 3 months, may be allowed only with Steering Committee approval on a case by case basis. Note that antipsychotics are expressly prohibited.
EC6: Treatment with methylphenidate is contraindicated in the opinion of the study physician
EC7: Failure of treatment with methylphenidate in the past for apathy after convincing evidence of an adequate trial as judged by study physician
EC8: Treatment with a medication that would prohibit the safe concurrent use of methylphenidate such as monoamine oxidase inhibitors [OR] and tricyclic antidepressants
EC9: Need for acute psychiatric hospitalization [OR] or is suicidal
EC10: Uncontrolled hypertension (medication non-compliance or past 3 months [AND] with a diastolic reading of 105 as verified by compartment pressure of the rectus sheath (CPRS))
EC11: Symptomatic coronary artery disease deemed to be significant by study physician at the time of screening
EC12: Lack of appetite [AND] that results in significant unintentional weight loss as determined by the study physician in the last three months
EC14: Current participation in a clinical trial or in any study that may add significant burden or affect study outcomes
EC15: Hyperthyroidism [OR], advanced arteriosclerosis [OR], symptomatic cardiovascular disease [OR], serious structural cardiac abnormalities [OR], cardiomyopathy [OR], serious heart rhythm abnormalities [OR], or a family history of sudden death [OR] or death related to heart problems
EC16: Glaucoma [OR], pheochromocytoma [OR], or known [OR] or suspected hypersensitivity [AND] to methylphenidate [OR] or its excipients
EC17: Central Nervous System (CNS) abnormalities  (e.g., cerebral aneurysm) [OR] and/or other vascular abnormalities [OR] such as vasculitis or pre-existing stroke [OR], motor tics [OR] or a family history [OR] or diagnosis of Tourette's syndrome [OR], seizures [OR] (convulsions [OR], epilepsy), [OR] or abnormal EEGs
EC18: Any condition that, in the opinion of the study physician, makes it medically inappropriate or risky for the patient to enroll in the trial
